name: reportbrains/filament-report-designer
description: Drag-and-drop report designer for FilamentPHP. Templates are stored as JSON and rendered to Markdown, HTML, PDF or spreadsheets.

suggest.chrome-php/chrome: Recommended PDF driver: renders with an installed Chrome or Chromium, no Node required (^1.16)
suggest.spatie/browsershot: PDF driver using headless Chrome through Node and Puppeteer (^5.0)
suggest.dompdf/dompdf: Pure-PHP PDF driver with no external dependencies; limited CSS, so output will not match the designer preview (^3.0)
